ground_truth.notes: 8-week 1-mile TT prep for an intermediate runner at 30 mpw. Volume stays close to current (30-35mi) across 4 sessions — the race is 4 minutes long, not 4 hours, so no massive volume build needed. The designated long run (Sunday) is capped at 5 miles, but the other 3 sessions can still be 6-8mi easy/quality runs. The entire quality focus is neuromuscular speed: short fast intervals (200m, 400m, 600m), strides, and race-pace reps. A 12-mile long run trains the wrong energy system for a 1-mile effort. 4 sessions/week.
